title: Dragon Mace by Hexafoxx
description: Dragon Mace add a new type of custom mace with a 30 second cooldown that shoots dragons breath with a custom recipe YOUR offhand bind to toggle ability
body:
**Dragon Mace**
Unleash the fury of the End with the Dragon Mace, a high-tier utility weapon designed for players who value both raw power and strategic control. Far more than a standard melee tool, this mace allows you to channel the essence of the Ender Dragon to dominate the battlefield from a distance.

Weapon Overview
The Dragon Mace is a specialized 1.21.11 PaperMC artifact that bridges the gap between traditional combat and magical prowess. By utilizing your offhand bind, you can instantly toggle and trigger its signature ability, allowing for fluid transitions between crushing hits and draconic breath attacks.

Core Mechanics
Draconic Breath Strike: Upon activation, the mace launches a high-velocity fireball that erupts into a lingering cloud of Dragon’s Breath.

Balanced Cooldown: To maintain competitive integrity, the ability is governed by a 30-second cooldown, tracked via a clean, high-visibility BossBar at the top of your screen.

Glint-Enhanced Aesthetics: The mace features a permanent enchantment glint for a "stare-worthy" legendary look, without cluttered enchantment text in the tooltip.
